title: The Invitation: Come, and Jesus' Final Words
description: Jesus confirms that he is coming soon with his reward to repay each person according to their deeds, and declares himself to be the Alpha and Omega, the Root of David, and the bright morning star. Blessed are those who wash their robes and gain access to the tree of life, while the unclean remain outside. The Spirit and the bride invite all who are thirsty to come and take the water of life freely.
